errors.text_span: Най-ниските стълбове са за 2017 и 2018 година
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the lowest bars are for 2017 and 2018. The lowest bar is for 2019 (value around 44,000). The bar for 2018 is the second lowest (around 54,000), but the bar for 2017 is one of the higher ones (around 80,000).

errors.text_span: Червеният сегмент, обозначаващ групата “Други”, е с най-малък дял за всяка година.
errors.evidence: The statement that the red segment ('Други') has the smallest share every year is false. For example, in 2014, the black ('Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа') and green ('Облигации') segments are visibly smaller than the red one. In several other years (e.g., 2012, 2013, 2015, 2016, 2019, 2020), the red segment is not present at all, so it cannot be the smallest.
